'''Morrng''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. He was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters Guild]], but was quite inexperienced. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was hired by [[Didina Lippinoss]] to kill [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]], who had been blackmailing her. However, ''en route'' to Bombaasa he was attacked by one of Bombaasa's underlings, who killed him.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateBountyHunter.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Morrng]]
Morrng was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. Due to the nature of many older [[:w:c:swg:Quest|quests]] in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', the [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and appearance of Morrng changed each time a player performed this quest. However, the quest dialogue given by Crev Bombassa established Morrng as a male Trandoshan.

Additionally, his name was inconsistently spelled as both "Morrng" and "Mornng." As "Morrng" appeared more often, this article assumes it to be the [[canon]]ical name.
